bayts.text: I have known — and I, through (divine) outpourings, bring forth new works — that the Originator (Al-Badīʿ) restrains, at all times, the abject one (al-ajdaʿ).
I have known with certainty that the Lord of the Throne has power over all things, and that He is for me, at all times, the refuge.
In Him I place my reliance, seeking the intercession of the Prophet: upon him God's blessing — how excellent an intercessor whose intercession is accepted!
Upon you, from the Lord, the Most High, His peace, together with your company, O you who intercede among creatures.
My hardship, by God's leave, you have erased from me, just as He has led to me what I hoped and longed for.
Upon you the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) who has guided and guarded me, for you are a creature excelling all the illustrious.
You are known as intercessor, saviour, bringer of succour: through you God has led to me what benefits at all times.
My sciences and my spiritual knowledge, through you God has led them to me: for you are the Chosen One, the noble Chief.
It is incumbent upon me, for the Face of God — sublime is His majesty —, to offer you at all times eulogies that exalt your merits.
My faults were once many, but you have erased them; and I used to entreat the Most High through the Effacer (Al-Māḥī).
I have pardoned all the enemies, for the Face of Him (Allah) who has driven them forever towards others than me: it is not I who repel them.
I have known with certainty that my Lord was with me, and that the one who came last (Al-Muqaffā, Muḥammad) repels whoever hates me.
My shelters a Protector who scatters (the enemies) has made pure: towards others than me, without any encounter, the enemies have scattered.
Once I raised a loud cry amid the enemies, striving, addressing Him (Allah) who forcefully drove the enemies away from me.
The appearance of the Messenger of God (Muḥammad) has led wishes to me, and he scattered every evil from me.
I have triumphed, and of the (divine) blessings I make mention, for I am the Servant (Khadīm) of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), and he guards.
I thirsted and came to the Sea (of grace), while I was upon the sea, as Servant of him (Muḥammad) whose words have put the ruby to shame.
My darkness the Chosen One (Muḥammad) once dispelled, and it vanished; by the sea I meet no one whose heart is hardened.
My vessels, all together, I once turned towards the Prophet, and each has become filled with what surpasses every wish.
I believed I had gathered in purity all that I sought, and my Lord has driven towards others than me what was burdensome.
The thirst of whoever heads towards the one who came last (Al-Muqaffā, Muḥammad) is the thirst of one who is given drink and food, and beholds with gladness.
The darkness of whoever heads towards the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad) is the darkness of one whose heart is illumined by him, while the rust (of the heart) is scraped away.
The presence of the Chosen One's Companions guards me, and towards the enemies there turns, from me, vigilance.
My shelters have spread as far as the Gardens of the Everlasting, and my whole being and my possessions a Defender who scatters (the enemies) has guarded.
My certainty is my God, and He gives life to my whole being, by the rank of the Messenger of God (Muḥammad), whose Path I revive.
My hand, my tongue, together with my heart and my body, my God has protected from all harm, erasing my error.
My eulogy spreads all the benefit the Prophet has gathered: he is the Sea, who draws (good) and drives away (evil).
In the Prophet's right hand are gifts for whoever asks; upon him the blessing of God, Lord of pardon and of right guidance.
In the Prophet's left hand are hidden things (punishments) for whoever assails; upon him the peace of God, who suffices against the oppressors.
My whole being dwells beside him, as his Servant, through him: through him I have become near, I who was far.
He makes me forever like his Family and his Companions, and has led to me a secret hidden even from the best, (by the grace of) the Giver of life (Allah).
The Everlasting (Allah) pours blessing and peace upon him, his Family and his Companions; through him I have attained triumph in the (wondrous) folding of the way (ṭayy).
He who frees from toil and from hoarding pours His blessing upon the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), upon all his Family and his Companions.
There speaks to me what has been led to me: "Praise him!", with a wondrous eulogy, that silences and surpasses all judgement.
The tongue of my state says to me: "Be the Servant of him (Muḥammad) who has protected you from troubles, by (the grace of) God, with attentive care."
(It is) my certainty, unto the Gardens, that the Everlasting loves me (and keeps from me) His enemies, and that through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) He gives life to my whole being.
By (the grace of) my Lord I have been given possession of what puts the wave and the sea to shame, by praising him (Muḥammad) who made me forget the ship's harm, as (one forgets) anguish.
My aim and my needs have turned to my Lord, with praise and thanksgiving, and He has been with me, lavishing gifts upon me.
My desire is to be servant of my Lord and Servant (Khadīm) of him (Muḥammad) whom I address with gratitude and love, with firm resolve.
Your merits, O my all, are manifest to all; but they are too sublime for poetry and verse.
The spiritual stations of the best of creatures are veiled (muqayyaba) from any but his Lord: so recite the Sūra of the Star (an-Najm).
Muḥammad, the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār): there is no creature like him; upon him the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) to whom belong command and judgement.
Muḥammad, the Renowned, the Effacer and the Giver, singled out with glory, guarded from every stain.
He who answers and is answered, the Well-pleasing, destroyer of enemies, who makes (the good) lawful, sent to the Arabs and the non-Arabs.
Luminous, he has dispelled our darkness from us, he makes lawful (what is pure), handsome, protected (by God) from people and from delusion.
City of knowledge, the Hoped-for, a (divine) grace for us, fearless and saviour from sins and from injustice.
God has erased from me, through the Prophet, all corruption, and through him I have become servant and Servant (Khadīm), without anguish.
From God, Lord of the Throne, I implore His blessing, together with His peace, for the Chosen One (Muḥammad), who puts the sea to shame (by his generosity).
